page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a baseline clock speed of 3.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 28 Gbps, supporting reliable data transfer rates for distributed environments.

The hardware profile of the ecs.g9i.16xlarge offers a balanced resource density, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring substantial compute power and memory without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. It is suited for workloads such as enterprise applications, web serving, database hosting, and general-purpose business-critical applications.
